jobs.occupation: Data Functional Analyst – SQL Server & Power BI
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead discussions with business stakeholders to identify and assess operational and analytics data flows.
• Translate complex business needs into detailed technical and functional requirements.
• Design and validate conceptual and logical data models in collaboration with architecture teams.
• Establish functional designs for data developments while ensuring compliance with governance and security standards.
• Oversee the testing of developed data products to ensure alignment with requirements.
• Support business users through information sessions and training to encourage the adoption of data solutions.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in data functional analysis and data flow design.
• 3+ years of technical experience with the MS on-premise stack, specifically SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, and Power BI.
• Proven experience in data warehouse modeling using the Kimball approach.
• You possess a Master’s degree in Computer Science or an equivalent field.
• You have strong SQL skills and high data literacy.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and autonomy.
• You are fluent in French and Dutch with active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Prior experience as a data engineer.
• Knowledge of Azure Databricks.

Responsibilities

• Manage the end-to-end address lifecycle, ensuring consistency across various network inventory and building databases.
• Develop and validate build lists for network deployment areas by reconciling multiple data sources.
• Maintain high data quality standards by performing pre-submission checks and correcting source data to meet contractual requirements.
• Build and reconcile databases for infrastructure assets, including poles and street capacity registers.
• Automate regulatory reporting processes to ensure reliable and efficient data submission.
• Support design engineering by creating validation rules and scripts using geospatial and data analysis tools.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to document workflows and share technical expertise.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience in data analysis, data quality, or data engineering within a geospatial context.
• You possess advanced proficiency in SQL for complex queries, joins, and cross-system data reconciliation.
• You bring strong scripting skills using Python and pandas for data processing and workflow automation.
• You have deep knowledge of geospatial data, including coordinate systems, spatial joins, and geometry data using QGIS.
• You have hands-on experience running and modifying ETL workflows such as FME.
• You possess a Bachelor or Master in Geomatics, GIS, Data Science, or Engineering.
• You're autonomous and proactive in resolving complex data issues and triaging tasks by impact.
• You are meticulous with address and geometry data and focus on repeatable, documented processes.
• You are fluent in French with professional knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Direct experience with PyQGIS or QGIS plugin development.
• Knowledge of regional address and cadastral references such as BeST Address, ICAR, or Belmap.
• Familiarity with telecommunications network inventories and infrastructure assets.
• Experience building internal tools with Power BI or Microsoft Fabric.
• Active knowledge of Dutch.

• You hold at least a Bachelor's degree,  
• A first professional experience is an asset, but motivated graduates looking to build a career in the events and hospitality industry are also encouraged to apply.  
• You are organised and enjoy managing multiple projects simultaneously.  
• You communicate professionally and are customer-oriented.  
• You are eager to learn, proactive and willing to take initiative.  
• You enjoy teamwork and contribute to a positive working environment.      
Languages

Experience within the events, congress, hospitality or catering sector is a plus, but motivation, curiosity and a customer-focused mindset are just as important to us.

Your role…
  
As a Cost Calculator you are responsible for developing and calculating accurate and competitive cost price calculations of our industrial vehicles and trailers. You collaborate closely with different stakeholders within our organisation; Engineering, Commercial, Purchasing, Production, in order to translate our customers' requests into an accurate budget estimate. After production of the vehicles you carry out a post-calculation in which you analyse the realised costs and margins. You investigate deviations and actively contribute to improve future cost price calculations.
  
 
  
Your responsibilities…
    
• You analyse customer requests, technical specifications and quotations in order to prepare budget estimates for the production of our industrial vehicles.  
• You will make cost price calculations and price analyses in Excel and our internal software system.  
• You take into account the required materials, components, working hours, etc and translate them into an accurate budget estimate.  
• You will work closely with the Engineering department to correctly interpret technical designs and product / material information.  
• Via our Purchasing team you request prices from our suppliers to support your calculations.  
• You perform post-production calculations and compare the actual costs with the pre-estimate so you can detect deviations and/or formulate optimizations and propose improvements for future calculations. 

Your profile…
    
• You have a Bachelor or Master in Engineering or a technical equivalent. Candidates with a financial or analytical background and strong affinity with technology and production are also welcome to apply.   
• Experience in a similar role is a plus but not a must.  Both junior and senior profiles are welcome.   
• You have a particular interest in numbers, a technical production environment, transportation.  
• You are detail oriented and work accurately.  
• You have numeric insight and possess strong analytical thinking.  
• You have a cost-focused mindset.  
• You are proficient in MS Excel and can work well with other MS Office SW.  
• You have excellent communication skills.  
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.

jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN to strengthen its Customer Service team on a temporary basis. Our client is a well-established international manufacturing and distribution company recognised for its commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. As a Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN your responsibilities are:

• Manage the complete order-to-cash process for a portfolio of domestic and international customers.
• Process, release, and monitor customer orders received through various channels, including e-commerce platforms, email, phone, and EDI.
• Provide customers with timely updates regarding order status, product availability, pricing, promotions, shipment tracking, and related documentation.
• Maintain accurate customer purchase order records within the ERP system for compliance and audit purposes.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain and Planning teams to validate customer demand against inventory availability.
• Manage backorders proactively and communicate alternative solutions when supply shortages arise.
• Coordinate shipments from multiple production sites and third-party suppliers while ensuring on-time delivery.
• Prepare and verify shipping, export, and customer-specific documentation.
• Handle debit and credit note administration.
• Respond to customer enquiries and manage claims related to logistics, quality, pricing, warranty, transport, and other service issues.
• Escalate complex cases according to internal procedures and ensure prompt resolution.
• Work cross-functionally with Sales, Logistics, Finance, Compliance, Marketing, and Product teams.
• Produce operational reports and analyse business data to support decision-making.
• Identify opportunities for process optimisation and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support the implementation of best practices and departmental performance standards.

A successful Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN should have:

• Holds a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Has initial experience within Customer Service, Customer Support, Order Management, Sales Administration, or Supply Chain Administration.
• Is fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Possesses a good working knowledge of French.
• Additional language skills are considered a strong asset.
• Has experience working with ERP systems, ideally SAP SD (Sales & Distribution).
• Demonstrates excellent proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
• Has strong communication, organisation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Is customer-focused and solutions-oriented.
• Can work independently while also being an effective team player.
• Remains calm and efficient in a fast-paced environment.
• Displays strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
• Adopts a continuous improvement mindset and strives for service excellence.
